$comment: EXP-1249: the launch composer's ONE '+' menu, byte-identical x4 (web components/launch-dialog/composer-menu.ts, desktop chat_screen.rs + launch_options.rs, iOS AgentComposerCard.swift, Android AgentComposer.kt). The '+' is the composer's ONLY tool (the Issue and Action tools and the options line's '...' overflow are gone); md+ = a dropdown anchored at the '+', phones = a bottom sheet of the same rows, submenus as pushed pages. Rows in `rows` order; a row with `when` renders only while that condition holds (`conditions` says when), then separators are TIDIED (never leading, trailing or doubled). Icons are CONCEPTS (packages/icons/icons.json). Submenus: implement-issue = the shared multi issue picker (search, the picks pinned first) with a footer button `implementButton` once something is picked (it only closes the menu: the picks are already the subject); run-action = the shared action picker (a pick sets the subject and closes the menu); effort = picker rows over the agent's efforts, value = the picked effort's label, label `codexLabel` for codex, DISABLED while ultracode is on; subagents = picker rows (Default + the contract coding models), value = the picked label; mcp-servers = multi picker rows over the team's servers (a server the caller has not connected opens Settings > MCP servers instead of toggling), value = the number picked (no value at zero). add-file opens the platform file chooser with NO type filter (any file: images up to 10 MB keep their [Image #N] marker, other files up to 50 MB ride as file links, 4 of each); iOS alone opens a two-entry GlassMenu 'Photo' | 'File' (the photo picker | fileImporter(.item)), the one iOS-only sub-choice. The options line under the card keeps Device, Account, Model, Plan, Resume and Repository and nothing else. Suggestions render BELOW the options line as quiet text rows (muted 13px, a faint `suggestions.icon` glyph, no pill, no border), `suggestions.count` of the chat-suggestions pool, only while there is no subject and the field is empty. A faint brand mark (the logo in the foreground colour at ~3.5% opacity, ~520px) sits behind the headline and the composer on the Agent page only, never in the composer dialog.

conditions.subagentModel: the picked agent takes a subagent model (claude)
conditions.mcp: the team has at least one MCP server and the subject does not own its MCP list (a real action)
conditions.computerUse: the picked device advertises the `computerUse.cap` capability

computerUse.$comment: Per-run computer use. The start payload key sits next to `mcpServerIds` in steer.startSession, codingSessions.start and the relay's start frame; true/false = this run, absent or null = the device's launch_defaults.computerUse. The toggle seeds from that device default on every device change and rides out only to a device advertising `cap` (older builds would ignore it).

cases.name: claude on a computer-use device with MCP servers: every row
codex, no MCP servers, no computer use: the last group goes with its separator
an action owning its MCP list on a computer-use device
codex with MCP servers on an older device
